claims.disproof_condition: Lower toward 3 when Aspina/Niron ship a commercial rare-earth-free motor adopted by any named robotics/appliance OEM, or a humanoid maker discloses a non-NdFeB joint motor; raise toward 5 if by 2028 iron nitride remains confined to low-flux applications (speakers/sensors) with no motor-grade product.
claims.statement: Substitutability valuation for the humanoid-actuator dependency on rare-earth (NdFeB) magnets: 4 of 5. Anchor from the substitute's own timeline: iron nitride's first commercial products are loudspeakers (June 2026, low flux-density application); motor solutions only entered development with Aspina in July 2026; heavy-rare-earth-free routes (Proterial) are still NdFeB. Rationale for 4 not 5: capital is committed to the alternative — Niron secured two $150M loans in August 2026 (DoW OSC 20-year term; SMSC) for its Sartell plant, so the substitution path is funded and directionally real, just not at motor grade. Using the substitute's self-report is conservative here (developers overstate readiness, so actual substitution is no closer than stated). Research judgment; both error directions in disproof.
